snippet.title: Ys vs. Trails in the Sky: Alternative Saga - Character Trailer (Nintendo Switch, PS4, PS5, PC)
snippet.description:
Legends unite as characters from the Ys and Trails series come together in a historic crossover RPG!

Join Adol Christin, Estelle Bright, and other beloved heroes as they embark on a journey to restore the lost land of Xanadu and face the looming threat of the Dragon King!
